steps.label: Step 3

steps.label: Step 6
steps.note:
Non-marked players stack on opposite side.
First cleaves go out

steps.label: Step 7
steps.note: heal inbetween cleaves, second set calls out markers

steps.label: Step 8
steps.note:
Adelphel jumps to a cardinal and goes untargetable.
Group position opposite side at Grinneaux' hitbox for KNOCKBACK (Arms length WORKS)

steps.label: Step 9
steps.note: Adelphel starts dashing, group moves towards the first cardinal he dashes to.

steps.label: Step 10
steps.note: MT moves away from group to bait Adelphel landing again with invuln

steps.label: Step 11
steps.note: Adelphel will start casting Holiest Hallowing. This needs to be interrupted

steps.label: Step 12
steps.note:
Loosely spread around the boss, ready to get marker/chain pairs
Preposition like so:
DPS W
Tanks N/NE
Healers S/SE

steps.note: knockback and explosions. feel free to adjust slightly to maximize distance so tethers break and explosions do not clip players.

steps.label: Step 15
steps.note:
Bring bosses back together. KILL THEM EVENLY or they enrage.
There will be a raidwide + in/out. Empty = in, Full = Out. Then another raidwide.
Adelphel needs to be interjected once more.

steps.label: Step 16
steps.note:
All players get imprisoned in the circle.
Two closest players to Chardibert get cleaves. 
Order is HMRT

steps.note:
Order is HMRT
Watch damage

steps.label: Step 18
steps.note: When the 5s sword debuff expires, a small aoe is snapshots wherever the debuffed player is standing. Cleaves repeat.

steps.note: Keep in mind there is some between getting Skyblind and the previous set of AoE going off. Be Patient
